items.title: George P. Fleming Interview, 1984-10-06
items.q: There was Sidney Dazman, Eugene Ware and I. Three trumpets

ctx.x: It was a guy by the name that had two, we used to call him Gene but his name was Eugene Hall and Eugene Ware. He was the piano man. Oh, he was a good pianist. And they had a guy by the name of Bucket was playing drums at that time. And so I used to go down there and those guys played such long hours until they was glad to see anybody because they had a horn come in to give them a little relief.
